title: OpenWaggle openwaggle.extension.json
description: The manifest of an OpenWaggle extension package: what it is, the files it ships, the capabilities it calls and where it shows up.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file.

id.description: Package id, the same as the package folder name: lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-", starting with a letter or digit.

version.description: Package version, a semver string raised with each update.

openwaggle.description: The extension API versions of the OpenWaggle host the package works with, a semver range such as ">=0.1.0 <0.2.0". The host API version and the @openwaggle/extension-sdk npm version are separate contracts: an SDK 0.3 package still names the host range.

sourceFiles.description: Every source file in the package. Paths relative to the package folder, with forward slashes.

builtArtifacts.description: Every built file OpenWaggle loads, local build outputs included. Paths relative to the package folder, with forward slashes.

source.description: prebuilt: the package ships its built files (the default). local-build: OpenWaggle runs build.command on the user’s machine.

command.description: The command that builds the package, run in the package folder.

outputs.description: The files the build writes. Defaults to builtArtifacts. Paths relative to the package folder, with forward slashes.

origins.description: External origins the package may reach, each an exact HTTPS origin with no path, such as https://api.github.com.

capabilities.description: The SDK capabilities the package calls, with their methods and scopes.

contributions.description: Contributions by family: where the package shows up in OpenWaggle.

resourceRoots.description: Folders of Pi resources (skills, extensions, prompts, themes) the package adds. Paths relative to the package folder, with forward slashes.

main.description: Trusted local code that runs in the main process.

renderer.description: Privileged renderer code. Every contribution with runtime "trusted-renderer" needs it.

runtimeRequirements.description: Programs the package needs. OpenWaggle checks for each one and never installs a missing program.
